acer - chromebook plus 514 14\" fhd+ tou.name: Acer - Chromebook Plus 514 14" FHD+ Touchscreen Laptop with Google AI - Intel Core 3 - 8GB RAM - 512GB Storage - Backlit - Steel Gray
acer - chromebook plus 514 14\" fhd+ tou.description: The Acer Chromebook Plus 514, designed for on-the-go productivity and entertainment, boasts a thin and light build weighing only 3.09 lbs, meets MIL-STD 810H military standards for reliable performance in harsh conditions, and comes with long battery life plus fast charge technology—letting you work, study, watch content, and stay connected without interruptions, making it perfect for commuting, travel, or working on the move; it unlocks AI-powered creativity through Google and Adobe AI tools that turn inspiration into reality faster, with its Gemini AI simplifying the organization of creative drafts and optimization of materials, a dedicated Quick Insert key generating high-resolution images and providing writing assistance for seamless creativity, and the inclusion of a 12-month Google One AI Premium plan (value $240 per year, with the Chromebook purchase) that grants access to Gemini Advanced, 2TB of cloud storage, and Gemini integration in Gmail, Docs, and more; powered by the 8-Core Intel Core i3-N355 Processor with Intel Graphics, it ensures smooth performance for everyday tasks, while 8GB LPDDR5X RAM enables fast, efficient multitasking and 512GB SSD offers ample space for files, apps, and media, delivering fast storage access and reduced load times; it features an excellent visual experience with a 14" WUXGA (1920x1200) IPS touchscreen boasting 300-nit brightness for vibrant visuals and responsive touch functionality, supports expanding the workspace with 3 external monitors via HDMI (max 4K@30Hz) or USB Type-C (max 4K@60Hz) without a docking station, and includes a 1080p webcam with a privacy shutter to prevent unauthorized viewing, meeting daily video chat or conference needs; for rich connectivity, it is equipped with 2x USB-C 3.2 Gen 1, 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1, HDMI 1.4, a headphone/microphone combo jack, and an IST Computers 7-in-1 Hub, plus Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 for blazing-fast wireless speeds and seamless device pairing, along with a white backlit keyboard that allows comfortable typing in any lighting; running on Google Chrome OS (with an Auto Update Expiration/AUE Date of June 2035), this Chromebook is built for the modern world—offering thousands of apps, built-in cloud backups, and Google Assistant, while being secure, fast, up-to-date, versatile, and simple—and is ideal for online courses, online school, college students, daily productivity, small businesses, Zoom meetings, video conferences, and more.
